telemetry_disclosure.answer: The host sends anonymous thread/turn/setup/failure events to PostHog; local agent-log usage accounting is a separate feature.

telemetry_defaults.answer: Privacy defaults productUsage to true. A build with no compiled PostHog key or WSP_ANALYTICS=0 sends nothing. This pass did not verify which published binaries include the key.

telemetry_controls.answer: The Privacy pages Anonymous usage counts switch updates productUsage; the host binding applies preference changes to its analytics client. WSP_ANALYTICS=0 is a separate overriding control.

telemetry_off_switch.answer: The in-app productUsage switch calls host setOn(false), which discards queued events and retries. Source/no-key builds already send nothing.

evidence.title: WSP readme
evidence.locator: Get started; Delegate across computers; Start from any surface; Thread isolation, shared files and lifecycle; Native desktop beta; License
evidence.finding: Documents a persistent host with desktop/CLI/MCP clients, user-controlled connected computers, optional cloud-enabled builds, thread trees and local worktree choices. Its License section explicitly says AGPL-3.0-only.

evidence.title: WSP apps/docs-next/content/features/agents.mdx
evidence.locator: Agents table; Sign in; Keep a key in wsps vault
evidence.finding: Explicitly separates four agents that run threads from catalog-only agents and documents their commands, native sign-ins and user-key routes.

evidence.title: WSP apps/docs-next/content/how/sign-ins.mdx
evidence.locator: Where a sign-in on a box ends up
evidence.finding: Describes per-computer native sign-ins, callback forwarding and separately stored user tokens; local logins are not blindly copied to remote computers.

evidence.title: WSP apps/docs-next/content/install/mac.mdx
evidence.locator: Install on Mac; direct DMG route
evidence.finding: The Mac app supports Apple Silicon and Intel and installs the wsp command.

evidence.title: WSP apps/docs-next/content/install/linux.mdx
evidence.finding: Linux AppImage targets x86_64 and includes the wsp CLI; the host runs as a user systemd unit.

evidence.title: WSP apps/docs-next/content/agents/coordinating.mdx
evidence.locator: Start each child; Give each ticket its own worktree; child reports and send commands
evidence.finding: A lead starts real child threads with wsp run, receives whole final messages through notify, reads/messages children and can place builders in explicit worktrees.

evidence.title: WSP apps/docs-next/content/features/changes.mdx
evidence.locator: Pick what to compare; Read the diff; Commit
evidence.finding: The Changes pane displays actual split/stacked diffs across branch, uncommitted, working-tree or staged scopes and supports selective-file commits.

evidence.title: WSP apps/web/src/diffs/DiffSurface.tsx
evidence.locator: DiffSurface; rendered file diff body and annotation paths
evidence.finding: The real web-rendered Changes interface consumes diff documents and renders code diff surfaces, changed-file controls and inline annotations.

evidence.title: WSP apps/docs-next/content/features/pull-requests.mdx
evidence.locator: How wsp reads a pull request; Merge; Open a pull request; Start a thread from a link
evidence.finding: Documents GitHub issue/PR intake, PR checks/comments/review, exact-head merges through the human gh identity and a separate topbar PR-creation flow.

evidence.title: WSP apps/desktop-gpui/app/src/screens/settings/pages/privacy.rs
evidence.finding: The native Privacy page has an Anonymous usage counts toggle, on by default; it reports env-disabled and no-key-build states separately.

evidence.title: WSP packages/host/src/analytics.ts
evidence.finding: Host telemetry posts bounded anonymous events to PostHog only in builds with a compiled key and enabled preference. No-key source/dev builds return NO_ANALYTICS; env0 also disables; setOn(false) clears queue/retry.

evidence.title: WSP packages/host/src/analytics-events.ts
evidence.locator: bindHostAnalytics preferences.changed and initial preferences read
evidence.finding: Host analytics reads productUsage initially and updates setOn from preferences.changed events.

evidence.title: WSP LICENSE
evidence.locator: AGPL Version3 text; explicit version-only selection is in README License and source SPDX.
evidence.finding: The file contains the AGPL version3 license text. README License explicitly selects AGPL-3.0-only; inspected source modules also carry that SPDX identifier.
